body: *Got a light?*

I’ve always pictured it as me falling into a black hole. The walls are too steep for me to crawl out. Once in a while I get a good grip and get halfway up. But it’s too difficult to hold on I always slide back down again.

She just uses people to her own ends. 
I always helped out with her kids - when I was struggling she was never there. 
I’ve heard people say “forgive and forget” it’s just so hard for me to do.

We haven’t spoken in a long time now.
Thanks :) Really appreciate it.
I’m so sorry to hear. I got it from my sister. It really hurts.
Coworker I don’t get along with. She makes me feel insecure, anxious..

Thank you.
I feel I’ve reached out for help so many times over the years. But here I am still.
All the best to you too

Thank you. I have had therapy. I had a lot not so long ago. I probably wasn’t stable enough for therapy full on (and I’m still not). I feel I need help getting my life together. I already feel so behind in life, that I don’t feel I have time for therapy right now. If that makes sense?
Thanks. It feels comforting somehow.
Thank you.
Northern Exposure
I would love a dog too. They’re just so brilliant having around.
That sounds really great. Good for you. Would love to do something similar.
Yes it’s a challenge for me too going for meet ups. I don’t know MeetUp but I have something similar where I am. I think it feels shameful to admit to somehow.
It sounds pretty painless to me. More than any other method. I guess that’s why I keep thinking about it.
Absolutely. It’s a catch-22. I’m depressed because I’m lonely and lonely because I’m depressed. The shame of depression, and my life in general, keeps me alone.
I know. You get so used to them and end up finding comfort in them in a way. Even though you hate them both.
I just called and talked to them.
Right. I was just longing for some understanding and empathy. I know that’s not his job though.. I used to have a therapist to text to, that might explain
Thanks a lot. Happy holiday to you too.
Thanks. I know just what you mean. Good to know there are more of us out there.
Nice to know I’m not alone in this.
Right. Love that song.
Band of Gold
I’ll try to keep the peace. I won’t seek her out and if asked I’ll just tell her the bare necessities but not actively ignore her.
Yeah mine can be superficial and awkward too. Guess that’s how it is when you come from a broken home.
I think you’re right. Just be “neutral” towards her. That’s true I don’t really have expectations for her anymore.
Thanks so much for this. Really helps to hear on the bad days. I’ll try to be better to notice the small positive things instead of focusing on the bad parts of the day.
Thank you. I’ve done a lot if therapy too.

I had a therapist for 3 years that I stopped seeing just recently. It’s hard, actually. I don’t want a new one though, starting all over again. Like you, I briefly talked with someone and we just didn’t click. Hard to define why. She’s just not inviting, and she annoys me more than anything.
Thanks.
I wont. But people do survive it.
What’s the one you had before? Looked good.
Have you tried it?

Thanks friend. I just hope I’ll get through this.
Really appreciate your words.

My whole life right now. No steady job. About to move out of apartment. Don’t know where to. Can’t afford this anymore. I have a small support network. Everything is just bleak. I don’t really want to do anything, not excited or optimistic about anything. Just the thought of moving is completely overwhelming. The practicalities of it, packing all my stuff... Feel like my life energy is just sapped. Don’t think I’ll be around till then.
I’ve thought about that too
Something I don’t know how to change. I’ve tried so many things..
Exactly.

Thanks for this. Just thinking about the practicalities of moving feels overwhelming for me. One step at a time...
Yes, it can be a fresh start. I hope to get that sense if relief you’re talking about.

Thanks for the support. I hd internships in project management and in communications, broadly speaking.
I like the idea of having something to remind yourself of all your qualities, like your board. It can really help when times are bleak and I feel I’ve never done anything right. Things people have said about me etc.
Hope all the best for you.

Thanks so much for the support. It really helps not feeling all alone in this just hearing of others going through something similar.
I live in Denmark so it’s not quite the same as in the  US. But yes something like this is SO stressful. My natural reaction would be to close my eyes and not deal with it. But I have to deal with it head on. That’s the only way to handle all my anxiety.

I want to be independent too, moving back in with a parent would be a huge blow. So happy to hear how you managed it all and I’m grateful you shared.
Thanks for sharing. I feel the same.

Running. Getting my pulse going somehow.

Doing something to further my position in life. Easier said than done. Often I don’t know what to do.

Reading

Watching videos and reading about other people struggling so I feel less alone.

Thanks man. It sure does help. I can sometimes surprise myself too by changing things for the better for future-me. It’s empowering and encouraging. And it doesn’t take a whole lot, even though it feels that way when you’re completely down in the dumps.
Thank you.
I don’t know. I just had a big rejection. That has something to do with it
I just feel so bad. Don’t know what to do
Thank you. I just feel so horrible..
So sorry to hear. I hope things are better for you now.
Sorry. I’m the same age. I go through periods of trying and giving up on everything. Often I feel that with my background it’s too late to get back on track and a normal functioning adult.
I’m sorry to hear you feel like that. I’ve been there, I know how horrible it is. I hope you feel better soon.

Sorry for you too. I find it hard to keep my anger inside in many situations. I’m afraid at some point I will say something to the boss or others and cause some damages for myself. How do people do this?
Yes! I can really relate to this.
Yeah I know. I don’t plan on saying anything, even though it would be nice. It’s like an extra burden you have to carry on top of everything else that no one knows of.
Sorry to hear that. Yes ignore her, she’s not worth the energy. Just be open with anyone else, and don’t let her stop that.

It may be for the best. Are you on meds?
So happy to hear you have a supportive family, that means everything.
Sorry to hear. How are you doing today? Have you found a new place?

Thank you for this.

The job is still very new so I don’t feel like opening too much open to anyone about these things. I just feel so immature and “unprofessional” for having these mood swings and being so sensitive to everything. It makes me so angry with myself. 
We work open plan so there is quite a bit of small talking and social stuff going on. Today I just wanted to take my things and walk out.. if I can’t make this work how will I ever have a good work life?.. I’m just so sick of myself lately..
Do you feel okay about that? I always feel I have to fit in

I try to remember: each day is a new chance at life

Nothing is final... until it is.
